In d’you time

The business behind the bottle.

Made withd’you
Our partContent strategy · Production · Documentary series

Here’s the idea.

A skincare brand lets the audience into the everyday work of building a company.

We created a YouTube series following d’you in real time: quick commerce, operations, packaging, demand, and growth. The material comes from the day-to-day decisions of the business.

The format moves away from conventional skincare content towards observational storytelling. Long-form episodes and short-form extensions share the same unvarnished view of work as it happens.

The process can be the story, if you let people close enough to see it.
